Settings: Lower draws fewer pixels: faster on the car's processor and lighter on memory, a little blurrier. The page keeps its layout.
设置: 较低的分辨率会减少绘制像素，让车机运行更快、占用更少内存，画面会略微模糊。网页布局不变。

Settings: More memory lets bigger pages and games load, but leaves less to the car's own screens, which may get slower while a big page runs. Only the browser itself can run out.
设置: 提高内存上限可加载更大的网页和游戏，但会减少原车界面可用内存，运行大型网页时原车界面可能变慢。该上限仅约束浏览器进程。

Settings: GPU mode (experimental): WebGL on the car's own graphics driver instead of the CPU. Chromium restarts for it, and it is off again whenever the tool starts. If the screen ever freezes or goes black, the car restarts and comes back without it.
设置: GPU 模式（实验性）：WebGL 使用原车显卡驱动绘制，取代 CPU 软件绘制。切换时会重启 Chromium；后台组件每次启动后默认关闭。如果画面冻结或黑屏，车机会重启，并在恢复后关闭此模式。

Settings: Game mode (experimental): WebGPU stops checking each command a page sends, which saves time in games. Only for sites you trust: a page with mistakes can crash the browser's graphics. Chromium restarts for it, and it is off again whenever the tool starts. While it is on, the other tools are asked to make way: a Steam game stops, and Cast pauses on the cluster and the HUD. A Steam game started later stops the browser until it ends.
设置: 游戏模式（实验性）：WebGPU 跳过网页命令检查，降低游戏开销。仅用于可信网站，网页错误可能导致浏览器图形进程崩溃。切换时会重启 Chromium；后台组件每次启动后默认关闭。开启时会停止 Steam 游戏并暂停仪表和 HUD 投射；之后启动 Steam 游戏会暂时停止浏览器，直到游戏退出。
实验性：仅用于可信游戏
